concussive.label: Concussive
concussive.description: On a successful attack, spend 1 Hope to knock target to Very Close

savage.label: Savage
savage.description: When you deal Major+ damage, the target marks 1 Stress

crushing.label: Crushing
crushing.description: Against armoured targets, roll two damage dice and take the highest

powerful.label: Powerful
powerful.description: -1 to Evasion; on success, roll two damage dice and take the highest

brutal.label: Brutal
brutal.description: -1 to Evasion; when you roll max damage, roll the die again and add to total

massive.label: Massive
massive.description: -1 to Evasion; roll an extra damage die and drop the lowest on hit

thrown.label: Thrown
thrown.description: Mark 1 Stress to throw up to Close with ADV

vault.label: Vault
vault.description: On a successful attack, mark 1 Stress to move within Very Close

quick.label: Quick
quick.description: Mark 1 Stress to target another creature within range

dueling.label: Dueling
dueling.description: Gain ADV on the attack if none of the target's allies are within Close

startling.label: Startling
startling.description: Mark 1 Stress to force all adversaries in Melee back to Very Close

paired.label: Paired
paired.description: +2 to primary weapon damage to targets within Melee

mark1stress.label: mark 1 Stress
mark1stress.description: to roll 1d6. If your roll matches one of the attacker’s damage dice, cancel one matching die before damage is totaled.

reloading.label: Reloading
reloading.description: After you attack, roll a d6; on a 1, mark 1 Stress to reload

blackpowder.label: Blackpowder
blackpowder.description:
Blackpowder weapons share the feature Blackpowder.

  • Deadly: When you deal Severe damage, the target marks 1 extra HP.
  • Loud: The shot is noisy and attracts attention.
  • Reloading: After you attack, roll a d6. On a 1, mark 1 Stress to reload before firing again.

destructive.label: Destructive
destructive.description: Mark 1 Stress to force all targets within Very Close to make a Finesse Reaction Roll (15) or take half damage
